## About the project

This is an open source Python package for declarative numerical analytics in industrial use cases.

## Coding guidelines

* Write clean and simple code
* Make code modular
  * Avoid long messy scripts
  * Reuse blocks of code
* Prefer foundational well-tested frameworks and technologies
* Use declarative configuration instead of in-script parameters
* Do not just add new code but remove redundant sections

## Coding style

* Write Python docstrings in Google style, using sections such as `Args:`, `Returns:`, and `Raises:` where applicable
* Update docstrings and add type hints when code changes

## File organization

Before coding, read these readme files to understand the project structure:

* readme.md - project overview
* docs - Full project documentation with sub sections
* examples - Example project and specification files

## Documentation instruction

When writing documentation, follow these instructions:

* Think independently
* Write in your own words
* Do not stick too closely to the existing documentation
* Reorganize texts when there is duplication or poorly written paragraphs
* Add missing information

## Terminal commands

* Run Python scripts using poetry

## Tests

After major changes run unit tests. Prompt to fix any contradictions.

## Local MCP servers

Use local MCP servers when available.
